metadata.question: Did the regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland experience at least 45 centimeters of rainfall between January 27 to February 10, 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in specific regions around Mount Isa and Townsville in Queensland between January 27 to February 10, 2019. They want to know if there was at least 45 cm (450 mm) of rainfall. For rainfall data, I should use: - CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - good for rainfall analysis - Time period: 2019-01-27 to 2019-02-10 - Locations: Need to define geometries around Mount Isa and Townsville Strategy: 1. Define Point geometries for Mount Isa and Townsville with buffers to create regions 2. Use CHIRPS daily precipitation data 3. Sum rainfall over the date range for each region 4. Check if rainfall >= 450 mm (45 cm) 5. Handle cases where no data is available I need to: - Check collection size - Calculate total rainfall - Validate the results - Output appropriate answer tag Let me create reasonable geometries around both locations: - Mount Isa: approx (-20.725, 139.492) - Townsville: approx (-19.259, 146.817) - Use 50km buffers around each ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mountIsa = ee.Geometry.Point([139.492, -20.725]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer const townsville = ee.Geometry.Point([146.817, -19.259]).buffer(50000); // 50km buffer const startDate = '2019-01-27'; const endDate = '2019-02-10'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS for rainfall const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const chirpsSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`CHIRPS Images: ${chirpsSize}`); if (chirpsSize === 0) { console.log("No rainfall data found for the period."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate total rainfall const totalRainfall = chirps.select('precipitation').sum(); // 4. Calculate rainfall for each region and check pixel counts const mountIsaRainfall = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const townsvilleRainfall = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); // Check pixel counts to ensure valid data const mountIsaCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mountIsa, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const townsvilleCount = totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: townsville, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation'); const [mountIsaRain, townsvilleRain, mountIsaPixels, townsvillePixels] = await Promise.all([ mountIsaRainfall.getInfo(), townsvilleRainfall.getInfo(), mountIsaCount.getInfo(), townsvilleCount.getInfo() ]); console.log(`Mount Isa: ${mountIsaRain?.toFixed(1)}mm, Pixels: ${mountIsaPixels}`); console.log(`Townsville: ${townsvilleRain?.toFixed(1)}mm, Pixels: ${townsvillePixels}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (mountIsaRain === null || townsvilleRain === null || mountIsaPixels === 0 || townsvillePixels === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in one or both regions."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (isNaN(mountIsaRain) || isNaN(townsvilleRain) || mountIsaRain < 0 || townsvilleRain < 0) { console.log("Invalid rainfall values calculated."); console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if both regions had at least 450mm (45cm) of rainfall const mountIsaMetTarget = mountIsaRain >= 450; const townsvilleMetTarget = townsvilleRain >= 450; console.log(`Mount Isa >=450mm: ${mountIsaMetTarget}`); console.log(`Townsville >=450mm: ${townsvilleMetTarget}`); if (mountIsaMetTarget && townsvilleMetTarget) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
